profile.headline: I set up AI coding agents for small teams | Running 10 products with one person and a team of agents
profile.summary:
I build and run 10 live products with a team of AI agents: Claude Code, Codex and an always-on server agent that write, review and ship code every day.
I now set the same up for small dev teams in a one-week sprint: agents that follow your conventions, a review agent on your pull requests, and automations for the busywork around the code. Fixed scope and price.
If your team is fighting with AI tools, message me.

positions.title: Certified Trainer
positions.description:
- Lead public speaking trainings, clients included Google, Facebook, Apple, Saleforce, Sony, etc. Ranks ranging from ICs to VPs, and C-levels.
- Grossed over 250k/yearly in sales
- Articulated complex ideas to teams of people
- Training Intro Clip: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uqRW_g-2kNk

- Used systems to scale up team for success
- Remained calm under stressful circumstances
